# orders-api configuration module (Cloud Run)

Generated by `docuconf terraform -target cloudrun` from the `orders-api` contract. It takes one argument per input, checks it against the contract, and renders a Cloud Run container's `env`, and the secret volumes and mounts of its file inputs. See [spec/IAC.md](https://github.com/Docuconf/docuconf-go/blob/main/spec/IAC.md).

| Input | Type | Required | Set with | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` | list |  | `value`, `injected` | Origins allowed to call the API from a browser |
| `DATABASE_URL` | url, secret | yes | `secret`, `injected` | Postgres connection string for the orders database |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | enum |  | `value`, `injected` | Minimum log level emitted |
| `PORT` | int |  | `value`, `injected` | HTTP listen port |
| `REQUEST_TIMEOUT` | duration |  | `value`, `injected` | Time limit for handling one request |
| `WEBHOOK_KEYS` | keySet, secret |  | `secret`, `injected` | Keys that verify the signature on incoming payment webhooks |
| `WORKER_COUNT` | int |  | `value`, `injected` | Number of background workers processing orders |
| `discounts` | config file at `/etc/orders/discounts/discounts.yaml` |  | `secret`, `injected` | Discount codes accepted at checkout |

A secret is a Secret Manager secret, by ID or as `projects/PROJECT/secrets/SECRET`, and a `version`, `latest` by default. The service account the revision runs as must be allowed to access each (`roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor`). A file input is mounted from a secret, one file per secret; tls inputs, which are directories, and overlays, which need a ConfigMap, are not part of this module.

## Usage

```hcl
module "orders_api_config" {
  source = "./modules/orders-api-config"
  DATABASE_URL = { secret = { secret = google_secret_manager_secret.database_url.secret_id } }
}

resource "google_cloud_run_v2_service" "app" {
  # …
  template {
    containers {
      image = var.image
      dynamic "env" {
        for_each = module.orders_api_config.cloudrun_env
        content {
          name  = env.value.name
          value = env.value.value
          dynamic "value_source" {
            for_each = env.value.value_from == null ? [] : [env.value.value_from]
            content {
              secret_key_ref {
                secret  = value_source.value.secret_key_ref.secret
                version = value_source.value.secret_key_ref.version
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
      dynamic "volume_mounts" {
        for_each = module.orders_api_config.cloudrun_volume_mounts
        content {
          name       = volume_mounts.value.name
          mount_path = volume_mounts.value.mount_path
        }
      }
    }
    dynamic "volumes" {
      for_each = module.orders_api_config.cloudrun_volumes
      content {
        name = volumes.value.name
        secret {
          secret       = volumes.value.secret.secret
          default_mode = volumes.value.secret.default_mode
          dynamic "items" {
            for_each = volumes.value.secret.items
            content {
              version = items.value.version
              path    = items.value.path
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```
